title: Generate Tag for Video Caption
summary: Given a video caption as a string, create a valid tag by combining all words into a camelCase format starting with '#'.
statement: Given a video caption as a string, create a valid tag by combining all words into a camelCase format starting with '#'. Capitalize the first letter of each word except the first, and ensure all subsequent letters are lowercase. Remove non-English letters except the initial '#'. Finally, limit the tag to a maximum of 100 characters.
constraints: Split the caption into words and combine them in camelCase after a leading #.
Lowercase the first word; capitalize only the first letter of each later word and lowercase its remainder.
Remove non-English letters and truncate the final tag to at most 100 characters.
reference_solution:
def generate_video_caption_tag(caption):
    words=caption.split()
    body=''.join(word.lower() if i==0 else word[:1].upper()+word[1:].lower() for i,word in enumerate(words))
    body=''.join(char for char in body if char.isalpha())
    return ('#'+body)[:100]
